Use This Form to Change Your Plan Option:
Change in Degree Plan Form
GS-115 Credit by Examination Report
On this form, the Instructor Grading the Exam will enter all relevant names and then start the routing. The Instructor Grading the Exam fills in their assigned information and signs, then the form will route to all others entered. Contact our office if your College or Department needs assistance or has questions.
Master's - Courses Only Requirements
GS-105 Master's Degree Comprehensive Examination Report (Courses Only)
On this form, the student will enter all relevant names and then start the routing. The student fills in their assigned information and the Graduate Coordinator is most often the person who will fill in the rest of the form. Contact our office if your College or Department operates in a different manner.
Master's - Research Project Requirements
GS-103 Research Project Final Submission and Comprehensive Exam Report
On this form, the student will enter all relevant names and then start the routing. The project supervisor will fill in the rest, and it will route to all who need to sign.
GS-110 Turnitin Report
This is required for a thesis, research project, and doctoral candidates. It allows for the remote submission of the Turnitin Report, along with the faculty mentor's signature and any required explanation for similarity rates equal to or greater than 15%. There is an upload button for the faculty member to use to insert the Turnitin Report PDF.
Master's - Thesis Requirements
GS-100 Thesis Proposal Submission Form
This is required for thesis master's candidates. On this form, the student will enter all relevant names and then start the routing. The student will attach their abstract page and fill in their assigned information. The committee chair will fill in the rest, and then it will route for the rest of the signatures. The formal signature page is not required for the proposal.
If your committee includes members who are not employees of TAMUK, you must use the GS-100 addendum form below. They cannot be added to the main GS-100. You will need to complete the required fields and then send the PDF document to them for their signature. Once they have signed, return the form to Graduate Studies: graduatestudies@tamuk.edu.
GS-100 Addendum
Thesis Submission Link
Students, click on the above link to submit your manuscript. Fill in the information on the digital form and upload your WORD file. There is a 1GB file size limit so keep photos and other graphics between 150 and 300 dpi.
GS-101 Thesis Final Defense & Comprehensive Examination Report Form
This form is required for candidates following the thesis master's degree path. It includes the Comprehensive Exam results as well as documents of the Thesis Defense. On this form, the student will enter all relevant names and then start the routing. The committee chair is usually the one to enter the exam and defense Pass or Fail information.
If your committee includes members who are not employees of TAMUK, you must use the GS-101 addendum form below. They cannot be added to the main GS-101. You will need to complete the required fields and then send the PDF document to them for their signature. Once they have signed, return the form to Graduate Studies: graduatestudies@tamuk.edu.

This is required for a thesis, research project, and doctoral candidates. It allows for the remote submission of the Turnitin Report, along with the faculty mentor's signature and any required explanation for similarity rates greater than 15%. There is an upload button for the faculty member to use to insert the Turnitin Report PDF.

Manuscript Resources
Resources
Instructions Concerning the Preparation of Theses and Dissertations (Manuscript Manual) – updated 09/17/2025
This document is the standard by which your thesis or dissertation will be reviewed to determine if it adheres to the quality control requirements for publication. Use it to determine how to format, prepare, and arrange your document appropriately. . The Committee and Student will need to verify that the document is set up correctly prior to submitting to the College of Graduate Studies for review and publication approval. When using a journal as a formatting guide, if the journal does not specify rules, this format will supersede the journal. If using a journal, you are required to submit the formatting guidelines to Graduate Studies.
Check out our workshop by clicking here.
Basic Thesis and Dissertation Microsoft Word Template. (Manuscript Template) – updated 10/13/2026
This Microsoft Word template is a tool intended to be a guide to assist in basic formatting for your thesis or dissertation manuscript.
It is to be used while simultaneously referencing the Instructions Concerning the Preparation of Theses and Dissertations, found above.
The template is provided to assist with the process, but is not a substitute for checking your own formatting and adherence to the rules set forth in the Instructions Concerning the Preparation of Theses and Dissertations. The Committee and Student will still need to verify that the document is set up correctly prior to submitting it to the College of Graduate Studies for review and publication approval. When using a journal as a formatting guide, if the journal does not specify rules, this format will supersede the journal. If using a journal, you are required to submit the formatting guidelines to Graduate Studies.
Common Error Checklist - updated 02/17/2022
This list is a breakdown of what are some of the most common errors found in the manuscripts submitted to Graduate Studies. Please utilize this list to aid you when writing your manuscript.
All Manuscripts Margin Template
This can be used to check the formatting of your manuscript. Important to note are the following requirements: 1" margins, page numbers 1/2" from the bottom of the page,r Times New Roman font, style, and 12 pt font size.
Common Examples - updated 02/17/2022
This document is a breakdown of some examples of errors and correct usage. Please utilize these examples to assist you when writing your manuscript.
University Writing Center
We offer free writing support to TAMUK students, faculty, and staff. Accomplished graduate and undergraduate students make up our staff of dedicated tutors. We work with writers through all stages of the writing process, from brainstorming and organizing to revising and polishing. While face-to-face, in-person appointments are the ideal way to experience our services, students (especially distance learners) can also make online appointments.
The Writing Center is able to work with the student on a section of the manuscript, to show how -to proceed for the rest of the document.

Additional Resources
Research Compliance Information
Some research will require a Research Compliance protocol to be in place before activity can begin. Working with Human Subjects, Vertebrate Animals, Biohazards, and items or activities covered under Export Control Guidance will need to be reviewed. Appropriate training will be required. Students require a Supervising Faculty Mentor to file their protocol and to act as the immediate oversight for the project, students of any level cannot be a Principal Investigator for a research project. They are listed as Student Investigators. Please contact Research Compliance (361-593-3344) to see if you need to have a protocol submitted.
Graduate Council
The Texas A&M University-Kingsville Graduate Council is charged with the overview of all Graduate Affairs. It is the responsibility of the Graduate Council to review all proposals for graduate degree programs and courses and, at its option, existing programs and to review the criteria for membership on the Graduate Faculty.
Furthermore, the council is to establish admission standards, standards for the continuation of graduate students, and residency requirements. Finally, the council is to consider any other matters relevant to the College of Graduate Studies.
